# Beatus Mídias

> Paid traffic and AI agency (Meta Ads, Google Ads, AI assistant that replies in seconds, CRM and follow-up, live dashboard). Serves US restaurants and delivery brands, US dental practices, and clinics and service businesses in Portugal (in European Portuguese). Legal name Bruno Lucas Marketing LTDA, CNPJ 48.414.383/0001-70. Contact: hello@beatusmidias.com. Brazilian site: https://beatusmidias.com.br/

## Restaurants (US)
- [Restaurant marketing agency, home](https://beatusmidias.com/): paid traffic, AI follow-up and a direct ordering channel for restaurants
- [Restaurant Marketing Agency: What It Does and How to Choose One](https://beatusmidias.com/blog/restaurant-marketing-agency/): What a restaurant marketing agency should do, what it should measure, how pricing usually works and the questions to ask before you hire one.
- [Facebook and Instagram Ads for Restaurants: A Practical Guide](https://beatusmidias.com/blog/facebook-ads-for-restaurants/): How to run Facebook and Instagram ads for a restaurant: the right objective, the delivery area, menu-first creative, offers and how to measure cost per order.
- [Google Ads for Restaurants: Which Searches Are Worth Paying For](https://beatusmidias.com/blog/google-ads-for-restaurants/): How restaurants should use Google Ads: high-intent local searches, the right area, negative keywords, Maps visibility and tracking orders and calls.
- [How to Get More Online Orders for Your Restaurant](https://beatusmidias.com/blog/how-to-get-more-online-orders/): A practical system to get more online orders: a fast direct ordering page, paid ads that point to it, a strong Google profile, quick replies and repeat order offers.
- [DoorDash vs Uber Eats Fees for Restaurants: What You Actually Pay](https://beatusmidias.com/blog/doordash-uber-eats-fees/): DoorDash and Uber Eats commission rates by plan, what they mean on a real order and how restaurants keep more margin by growing a direct ordering channel.
- [Commission-Free Online Ordering: How to Build a Direct Ordering Channel](https://beatusmidias.com/blog/commission-free-online-ordering/): How restaurants build a commission-free direct ordering channel: the options, what it costs, how to send traffic to it and how to move regulars off the apps.
- [Restaurant SMS Marketing: How to Text Customers the Right Way](https://beatusmidias.com/blog/restaurant-sms-marketing/): How restaurants use SMS marketing for repeat orders: getting written consent, what to send, how often, and how to make opting out easy under FCC rules.
- [Restaurant Customer Retention: How to Turn First Orders Into Regulars](https://beatusmidias.com/blog/restaurant-customer-retention/): Restaurant customer retention in practice: capture contacts with consent, follow up after the first order, use win-back offers and measure repeat rate.
- [How Much Should a Restaurant Spend on Marketing? A Practical Way to Decide](https://beatusmidias.com/blog/restaurant-marketing-budget/): How to set a restaurant marketing budget from your own numbers: average ticket, margin, value of a repeat customer and kitchen capacity, then test and scale.
- [AI for Restaurants: Using an AI Assistant to Answer Customers and Take More Orders](https://beatusmidias.com/blog/ai-for-restaurants/): How restaurants use an AI assistant: instant replies to questions about menu, hours and delivery area, guiding customers to order, and follow-up, with a human in charge.
- [Pizza Restaurant Marketing: How to Sell More Pies Without Living on the Apps](https://beatusmidias.com/blog/pizza-restaurant-marketing/): Pizza restaurant marketing that sells: local Google and Meta ads, menu-first creative, a direct ordering page, fast replies and offers that bring families back.
- [Coffee Shop Marketing: How to Win the Morning Routine in Your Neighborhood](https://beatusmidias.com/blog/coffee-shop-marketing/): Coffee shop marketing built around routines: a sharp Google profile, tight local ads, order-ahead, a simple loyalty program and offers for slow afternoon hours.
- [Bakery Marketing: How to Sell Out Daily Bakes and Fill Your Pre-Order Calendar](https://beatusmidias.com/blog/bakery-marketing/): Bakery marketing that fills the calendar: seasonal pre-orders, Google searches for custom cakes, menu-first ads, fast quote replies and reminders for regulars.
- [Food Truck Marketing: How to Bring the Crowd Wherever You Park](https://beatusmidias.com/blog/food-truck-marketing/): Food truck marketing that follows the truck: a weekly schedule people can find, local ads around each stop, a text list for regulars and event and catering bookings.
- [Catering Marketing: How Restaurants Win More Catering Orders](https://beatusmidias.com/blog/catering-marketing/): Catering marketing for restaurants and caterers: clear packages, Google ads for catering searches, fast quotes, follow-up for recurring office orders and reviews.
- [Ghost Kitchen Marketing: How Delivery-Only Brands Get Found and Reordered](https://beatusmidias.com/blog/ghost-kitchen-marketing/): Ghost kitchen marketing for delivery-only brands: strong app listings, paid ads in the delivery zone, a direct ordering channel and packaging that drives reorders.
- [Bar Marketing: How to Fill Slow Nights and Book More Events](https://beatusmidias.com/blog/bar-marketing/): Bar marketing that fills the room: a strong Google profile, event-led promotion, food and experience creative, private event bookings and a list of regulars.
- [Restaurant Email Marketing: Emails That Bring Customers Back to Order](https://beatusmidias.com/blog/restaurant-email-marketing/): Restaurant email marketing that drives orders: building a list with consent, automated welcome and win-back flows, campaign ideas and the CAN-SPAM basics from the FTC.
- [Restaurant Loyalty Program: How to Design One That Brings Customers Back](https://beatusmidias.com/blog/restaurant-loyalty-program/): How to build a restaurant loyalty program that works: choosing points, visits or tiers, picking rewards that protect margin and tying it to your direct ordering.
- [Restaurant Google Business Profile: How to Set It Up to Win Local Searches](https://beatusmidias.com/blog/restaurant-google-business-profile/): How to optimize a restaurant Google Business Profile: categories, hours, menu, photos, order link, reviews and posts, plus what Google says decides local ranking.

- [AI Assistants for Dental Practices: What They Should and Shouldn't Do](https://beatusmidias.com/dentists/blog/ai-assistant-for-dental-practices/): What an AI assistant should do for a dental practice: reply to every inquiry in seconds, answer from approved information, offer appointment times and hand clinical questions to the team.
- [Why Dental Leads Go Cold, and How to Follow Up](https://beatusmidias.com/dentists/blog/dental-lead-follow-up/): Why dental leads go cold and the follow-up system that fixes it: reply speed, missed calls, one simple pipeline and a respectful sequence for people who don't book right away.
- [Google Business Profile for Dentists: How to Win the Map](https://beatusmidias.com/dentists/blog/google-business-profile-for-dentists/): How dentists improve their Google Business Profile: the right categories, accurate hours, real photos, a steady flow of reviews, privacy-safe review replies and regular updates.
- [How Much Does a New Dental Patient Cost? How to Calculate It](https://beatusmidias.com/dentists/blog/cost-per-new-dental-patient/): How to calculate what a new dental patient costs and what one is worth: the formulas, the funnel numbers to track and how to decide how much to invest in marketing.
- [How to Reduce Dental No-Shows and Fill Hygiene Recall](https://beatusmidias.com/dentists/blog/dental-no-shows-and-recall/): How dental practices reduce no-shows and fill hygiene recall: confirmations people answer, reminders at the right time, easy rescheduling and a recall list someone actually works.
- [Dental Marketing Ideas That Actually Book Patients](https://beatusmidias.com/dentists/blog/dental-marketing-ideas/): Dental marketing ideas ranked by what they do for the schedule: quick wins with no ad spend, paid ideas that bring new patients and retention ideas that fill the calendar again.
- [Invisalign and Clear Aligner Marketing for Dentists](https://beatusmidias.com/dentists/blog/invisalign-marketing-for-dentists/): How dentists market Invisalign and clear aligners: which patients to reach, what the ads and page should show, how to answer price questions and how to follow up until the consult.
- [Emergency Dentist Marketing: How to Win Urgent Patients](https://beatusmidias.com/dentists/blog/emergency-dentist-marketing/): How dental practices win emergency patients: search ads for urgent intent, accurate hours on Google, one-tap calls, fast replies after hours and a path from emergency visit to regular care.
- [What a Dental Website Needs to Turn Visitors Into Appointments](https://beatusmidias.com/dentists/blog/dental-website-that-converts/): What a dental website needs to turn visitors into appointments: clear booking paths, treatment pages, insurance and payment information, fast mobile pages, real photos and accessibility.
- [Dental SEO: How Local Practices Show Up in Google Search](https://beatusmidias.com/dentists/blog/dental-seo-for-local-practices/): Dental SEO for local practices: the Google Business Profile, one page per treatment, consistent business information, reviews, helpful content and structured data, without shortcuts.
- [How to Choose a Dental Marketing Agency: Questions to Ask](https://beatusmidias.com/dentists/blog/how-to-choose-a-dental-marketing-agency/): How to choose a dental marketing agency: the questions to ask, the red flags to avoid, who should own your ad accounts and how results should be reported.
- [Dental New Patient Offers: What Works and What to Avoid](https://beatusmidias.com/dentists/blog/dental-new-patient-offers/): How dental practices use new patient offers: which offers bring patients who stay, how to word them, disclosure and regulatory points to check and how to measure them.
- [How the Dental Front Desk Turns More Calls Into Appointments](https://beatusmidias.com/dentists/blog/dental-front-desk-phone-calls/): How a dental front desk turns more phone calls into appointments: answer fast, call back missed calls, ask the right questions, handle price and insurance questions and always offer a time.
- [How Much Should a Dental Practice Spend on Marketing?](https://beatusmidias.com/dentists/blog/dental-marketing-budget/): How a dental practice can set its marketing budget: work backward from the new patients it needs, its cost per new patient and its capacity, instead of copying a generic percentage.
